parameters.value: A water ATM, also referred to as a water vending machine, is a self-service device that provides individuals with affordable and convenient access to safe, clean drinking water. These machines utilize advanced filtration technology to purify water. It features a self-service dispenser either free of cost or through payment via coins, smart cards, UPI, or other methods as applicable of Payment to deliver filtered drinking water. It is used in commercial spaces, public areas, hospitals, offices, institutions, and industrial locations, rural areas, CSR initiatives / piaui etc.

It consists majorly of rigid encloser / civil structure, water filtration system, water dispensing mechanism etc and incidental services. The machine shall be aesthetically designed should have sturdy construction, which should not get buckled or gets distorted during usage.
